desktop.notes: • Original card (details panel): the camera files (CR3 + JPG), their folder and drive, and whether they are connected now. Edit the original starts from the camera RAW (RAW as JPG), not the Library JPG or an edited copy; Show in folder shows it in Explorer. Found also when the drive got another letter (its serial number), when Cullect moved it inside the shoot (_saved, _keep…) or on a backup; a file with the same name but another size is never used. Originals are only read.
